page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at the top, page number at the top right. No marginal notes. Signature at the foot right.

main_text.p: nam pacto mortem Africani feras, coque magis, quòd is proximis nonis, cū in hortos Decii Bruti Auguris commentādi causa, (ut assolet) venissemus, tu non affuisti: qui diligentissimè semper illum diem, & illud munus solitus esse obire. S C AE V O L A. Quaeruntquidem, C. Laeli multi, ut est à Fannio dictum: sed ego id respondeo, quod animadverti te dolorem, quem acceperis cum summi viri, tum amantissimi morte, ferrè moderatè, nec potuisse non commoveri, nec fuisse id humanitatis tuæ. Quod autem his Nonis in nostro collegio non affuisses, valetudinem respondeo causam, non mœstitiam fuisse. L AE L. Rectè tu quidem, Scæ-vola, & verè. Nec enim ab isto officio, quod semper usurpavi cum valerem, deduci incomodo meo debui: nec ullo casu arbitror hoc constanti homini posse contingere, ut ulla intermissio fiat officij. page.notes: The line "Quaeruntquidem" is printed with a run-on word space. Small caps in "S C AE V O L A." and "L AE L." are kept as printed. The "Scæ" at the line end is a ligature, read as æ. The page ends mid-word with a printed hyphen, and the text goes on on the next page.
